opsx:apply.description: Apply an OpenSpec change: implement tasks from openspec/changes/<name>/
opsx:apply.template: Read .agents/commands/opsx/apply.md and execute its workflow for the given change. $ARGUMENTS

opsx:explore.description: Explore mode: clarify requirements and compare options before a change

opsx:extract.description: Extract knowledge from an archived OpenSpec change into docs/ and rules/

opsx:list.description: List all OpenSpec changes and their status

opsx:propose.description: Propose a new OpenSpec change with all artifacts in one step

opsx:note.description: 从会话/素材捕获讨论结论为 notes 暂存条目

opsx:ship.description: Ship a change: code review → commit → push → PR → archive

opsx:triage.description: 整理 notes：提升/折叠/失效/清理 archive

git-commit.description: Execute git commit with conventional commit message analysis, intelligent staging, message generation, and automatic push
git-commit.template: Read .agents/skills/git-commit/SKILL.md and execute its workflow. Do not commit or push unless the user asks. $ARGUMENTS

graphify.description: Turn the codebase into a persistent knowledge graph (HTML/JSON/report) and query it
graphify.template: Read .agents/skills/graphify/SKILL.md and follow it exactly (version pin in .graphify_version, references in references/). If graphify-out/graph.json already exists and the request is a natural-language codebase question, use the fast path: graphify query "<question>". Only produce graphify-out/ artifacts; never modify the scanned source tree. $ARGUMENTS
